questions.q:
Simplify to a single trigonometric ratio:
[sin(180° + x) · cos(90° − x) · tan(360° − x)] / [cos(90° + x) · sin(−x)]
questions.qAf:
Vereenvoudig tot ’n enkele trigonometriese verhouding:
[sin(180° + x) · cos(90° − x) · tan(360° − x)] / [cos(90° + x) · sin(−x)]
points: = sin²x tan x / sin²x = tan x

questions.q: Show that BD = d · sin(θ + β) / sin θ.
questions.qAf: Toon dat BD = d · sin(θ + β) / sin θ.
points: BD / sin∠BCD = d / sin θ (sine rule)
sin(180° − (θ + β)) = sin(θ + β), so BD = d · sin(θ + β)/sin θ
pointsAf: sin(180° − (θ + β)) = sin(θ + β), dus BD = d · sin(θ + β)/sin θ

pointsAf: h = BD · tan x = d · sin(θ + β) · tan x / sin θ
